sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests if a dismissal with prejudice creates a final judgment. This status allows a party to appeal to a higher court. The lower court dismissed the underlying claims. The parties disagree on the legal effect of that dismissal.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This dispute defines the scope of appellate jurisdiction. It determines when parties can challenge lower court dismissals. The outcome shapes federal civil procedure standards.
